source.folder_title: 131 - PubMed Search Results - Medication Study Designs 2000-2021

blocking_reason: The retrieved files are PubMed search-result pages, not primary literature. They contain search metadata and PMID lists but no article-level study assertions, methods, populations, exposures, outcomes, quantitative results, or bibliography that can support LiteratureAtom extraction.
source_integrity_findings: Each saved search page contains only the first 20 relevance-sorted PMIDs despite result counts ranging from 2040 to 130639.
The case-series query contains no medication or drug-therapy term.
The case-report query uses 2000:2022 rather than the folder's stated 2000:2021 scope.
The case-report query is restricted to selected bacterial resistance and infection concepts rather than general medication case reports.
English-language filtering is recorded for the systematic-review, review, randomized-trial, prospective, and retrospective pages, but not for the case-series or case-report pages.
The saved pages record the NCBI filter code simsearch2.ffrft. This report preserves the code without assigning an unsupported label to it.
reference_queue_reason: No primary article or article bibliography was present. The Markdown task queue therefore records the 140 PMIDs displayed by the seven search snapshots and labels them as search-result acquisition tasks, not article references.
extraction_limitations: No full article, abstract record, PDF, methods section, results section, figure, table, supplement, or bibliography was present in the target folder.
The 140 displayed PMIDs are a set of seven first-page snapshots, not complete exports of the underlying PubMed result sets.
No PMID titles or bibliographic metadata were added from external sources because @VERIFY was not activated.
